The '''Shrine of Silence''' was an important [[Voss (species)|Voss]] temple on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Following the [[Invasion of Voss]], it was heavily damaged by the [[Eternal Empire]]'s bombing and required the assistance of elements from the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] and the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="TOR" />
